newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bullish OLO market shrugs off Bfr underperformance.
newsitem.headline: Bullish OLO market shrugs off Bfr underperformance.

text.p: A bullish Belgian linear bond market shrugged off currency underperformance in early trade on Tuesday and dealers said supply of longer maturities at an exchange auction later could be easily absorbed.

The Belgian franc failed to benefit from the dollar's overnight gains against the mark, trading little changed at 20.6155/75 to the mark at midmorning. Forex traders could not explain the relative weakness.
OLO dealers said, however, it was no cause for concern. "Short rates are relatively stable," one noted. The 10-year OLO yield fell in early trade to 5.74 percent from 5.76 percent.
